content.text:
Done. All tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).

I added the per-country national-number check to `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.service` — the single lowest-impact edit:

- **One file touched**, and the class has only one method (WMC_other = 1), so the surrounding-complexity cost is minimal.
- Added two guard clauses right after the existing E.164 length check:
  - `+61` → must have 9 national digits (`count - 2`)
  - `+1` → must have 10 national digits (`count - 1`)
- Both throw the existing checked `InvalidTelephoneException`, which the existing handler already maps to **400**, so no new classes, escalation YAML, or wiring were needed.

The default valid payload (`04XXXXXXXX` → `+61` + 9 digits) and the `+1` NANP seed data (10 national digits) both still pass, and the new test rejecting `+61 123` returns 400.
